title: Funding Partnership Fit Map
description: Four funding needs, four partnership approaches, and which one solves more than one need.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a specific club funding need, the learner examines which partnership or negotiation approach from this chapter best addresses it.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click any need or approach for what it covers
pedagogical.assessment: Give a funding need and ask which approach fits and why the others do not.
